caveats: Region bounds snap to the 0.02-deg grid: cells analysed span 58.70-59.88 N, 18.70-19.88 E (60x60=3600 cells). SST in kelvin as stored; non-finite (fill) values treated as missing. 307 cells have non-finite SST on some baseline-window day; 307 cells are not sea cells (non-finite on some target day) and are 0 in the mask. Threshold = 90th percentile of the per-cell pool of SST values within +/-5 calendar days of each of the 11 baseline dates (1992-2002) sharing the day of year, computed as numpy quantile method='hazen' (Hyndman-Fan type 5); day-60 statistics are the mean of days 59 and 61; threshold and climatology then smoothed with an unweighted 31-day centred moving mean wrapping around the 366-day year; all statistics in float64. 2017 summer SST was within about 1 K of the 1992-2002 climatology (baseline hot-day fraction 9.5%), so no 5+ day hot runs occurred and no regional MHW events were detected.
